name: Hu tieu xuong
summary: The bone bowl of Mỹ Tho hủ tiếu, made from the same Mỹ Phong strands and eaten beside the satay and dry versions.
origin: Mỹ Tho, from the noodle craft of Mỹ Phong.
howToEat: Order it as the bone alternative to the satay and dry bowls of hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho.
where: The noodle craft is in Mỹ Phong and the neighboring wards of Mỹ Tho.
seoTitle: Hu tieu xuong in My Tho
seoDescription: Hủ tiếu xương, the bone bowl of Mỹ Tho rice noodles, eaten beside the satay and dry versions.
